registry.builtin_phase_repeated: %(phases)s in REFLECT_PHASES are built-in phases (commit / start-of-work cannot be duplicated and need not be re-declared) — drop them and keep only the custom phases
registry.dead_interface: public function `%(function)s` (in %(module)s) has **zero consumers** — defined but never used (zombie interface). Delete it, or make it private with a `_` prefix
registry.dependency_untested: `%(module)s.%(function)s()` is consumed by a gate but has **zero assertions** — if it judges wrong, the consuming gate loses its criteria while its own self-test stays green (a dead link in the dependency chain)
registry.empty_phase: phase %(phase)s has no runnable gates — zero-value guard: an empty list is not a pass (is the predicate or a declaration broken?)
registry.empty_roster: not a single gate was found — zero-value guard: an empty input is not a pass
registry.missing_declaration: these gates have no GATE = gate.meta(…) declaration line — the roster refuses nameless entries (handwritten rosters drift; a declaration is a registration): %(files)s
registry.name_dependent_wrong: `%(file)s` is flagged name_dependent but none of the knobs it consumes has a default name in the rename fixture list — the flag is wrong (either drop the flag or add the new default name to registry.RENAMED_DEFAULTS)
registry.no_module_selftest: no platform module self-test could be discovered — zero-value guard: an empty input is not a pass
registry.no_trailing_newline: file `%(file)s` does not end with a newline — the two ways of measuring `py_lines` (line-by-line read vs `cat|wc -l`) then differ by 1 and the replay gate is permanently red
registry.off_reason_stale: `%(file)s`'s `off_reason` claims this repo has no `%(name)s`, but it **does exist** — the reason is stale: the gate should be enabled and is not (off became a permanent exemption)
registry.off_reason_too_short: `%(file)s`'s `off_reason` is too short (%(reason)r) — an exemption must say why, same discipline as `PINNED:`
registry.off_reason_without_off: `%(file)s` declares `off_reason` but never calls `off()` — the reason is unwritten back (a lie)
registry.off_without_reason: `%(file)s` can call `off()` but declares no `off_reason` in `meta()` — a reasonless off is indistinguishable from 'this repo does not use this mechanism'
registry.open_without_encoding: text `open()` without `encoding=` (`%(file)s:%(lineno)d`, mode=%(mode)s) — Windows defaults to cp1252; UTF-8 files raise UnicodeDecodeError
registry.path_rule_split: `%(file)s`'s `%(function)s()` computes the tool directory itself (`dirname(abspath(__file__))`) — that value must have exactly one producer (`gate.zdir()`), otherwise changing one place splits it
registry.phase_error: ERROR %(file)s (executor-level breakage: rc<0 killed by signal, or >2 an unagreed code)
registry.phase_fatal: FATAL %(file)s (config/environment broken — not a check failure; different fix)
registry.phase_off: off    %(file)s (off — never checked, not a pass)
registry.phase_summary: phase %(phase)s: ran %(ran)d / off %(off)d / failed %(failed)d / fatal %(fatal)d / error %(error)d
registry.selftest_no_entry: these modules declare selftest=True but have no --selftest entry point — a self-test written but never run is decoration: %(files)s
registry.selftest_no_entry_cli: ❌ %(file)s declares a self-test but has no --selftest entry point (written but never run = decoration)
registry.subprocess_without_encoding: `subprocess.run(text=True)` without `encoding=` (`%(file)s:%(lineno)d`) — Windows defaults to cp1252; the reader thread dies and stdout becomes None
registry.suite_file_without_declaration: suite file `%(file)s` has no declaration line (module-level `MODULE = …` or `GATE = …`) — an undeclared file is treated as user code and the gates stop auditing it
registry.undeclared_module: these .py files are neither gates (no GATE declaration) nor declared platform modules (no MODULE = module_meta(…)) — a platform module must declare itself, even with selftest=False (state plainly that it needs no self-test): %(files)s
registry.unexpected_shell: unregistered shell file inside the suite: `%(file)s` — full-Python goal: shell is an exception; each one must be listed in `ALLOWED_SHELL` in `zreflect/criteria.py` (with a reason). **Your own repo's .sh files are not subject to this**
registry.unknown_phase: `%(file)s` declares runs_at=%(runs_at)r which is not a known phase (%(phases)s) — the frequency is a declaration field; a bad value makes the execution surface skip it
registry.system_exit_not_int: `raise SystemExit(...)` at `%(file)s:%(line)d` is given a non-int — `SystemExit(str)` exits **1** and `SystemExit()` exits **0**, both breaking the rc contract (0 green / 1 criterion red / 2 env broken). Use `gate.fatal_exit(msg)`
